title: IRIP Model Contract v1
description: Validation schema for IRIP model contracts (V2-T04). A model contract declares the model name, semantic version, input/output JSON Schemas, and applicability domain (per-dimension min/max ranges).

name.description: Model name, lowercase letters/digits/underscore, must start with a letter.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the model input parameters.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the model output parameters.

applicability_domain.description: Per-input-dimension min/max range defining the applicability domain.

executor.description: Optional executor specification describing how to run the model.

type.description: Adapter type: 'python' for in-process sklearn/pickle models, 'cli' for command-line models.

module.description: Python module path for python adapters (optional).
